title: Rubix
description: Scramble, turn, resize, undo, and automatically solve a tactile multi-size cube with direct drag controls and crisp turn audio.

prompt.objective: Build a tactile twisty-cube playground with direct layer gestures, multiple sizes, history, and guided solving.

mintAssets.brief: A clean rounded dark cubie shell designed for repeated grid assembly.
One short dry plastic speed-cube turn with a crisp detent click.

experience: Drag the cube to orbit it or turn a detected layer and depth.
Switch sizes, scramble, undo moves, and play automatic solutions with speed controls.
prompt.visualDirection: Minimal studio light, bold stickers, dark surfaces, precise motion, and compact controls.
